name: Cloakroom
desc1: Behind a small counter on the western wall, a young man waits to take
desc2: the cloaks and bags of weary travelers. The Homely Hearth has a
desc3: flawless reputation, and so these items are sure to be returned. Some
desc4: travelers leave their cloaks here, for whatever reason, and after a
desc5: while these are sold in this cloakroom. The closed door to the kitchen
desc6: is to the east, and you can exit into the stables to the south.
